policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: St. Thomas Aquinas have now met every other member and lost to none of them, and Daemen were the last to try. Molloy's win over Mercy pulls the two level on points behind D'Youville, while District of Columbia, winless in conference play before they beat Staten Island, have not dropped a point since.
